scope: fixed benchmark-harness confirmation and dispatch; not production DSH admission
fixture: independent foreground model turns plus one deterministic all-of branch turn; constrained GPU decoding fixes outputs, not a model-quality benchmark
io_accounting: fdatasync is measured separately; readback may be page-cache served; Linux per-thread I/O counters are reported as observed
primary_metric: nearest-rank P95 of all planned active roots per attempt, including the all-of root
failure_rule: no primary P95 or paired effect when any required worker/root fails or work differs
comparison_rule: median paired P95 reduction >5% and exact 95% paired median interval excludes zero
